# Types

Value types used across the API.

### Price {#price}

TAO per alpha.

```ts
type Price = number
```

### Ms {#ms}

Block timestamp in ms since epoch (UTC).

```ts
type Ms = number
```

### BlockNumber {#blocknumber}

A block height on the chain.

```ts
type BlockNumber = number
```

### IntentId {#intentid}

The id `trade.buy()` / `trade.sell()` return, e.g. "i3".

```ts
type IntentId = string
```

### Mode {#mode}

How the script is being run: drawn on the chart, backtested, paper traded on the live stream, or traded live.

```ts
type Mode = "indicator" | "backtest" | "forwardtest" | "live"
```

### ActOn {#acton}

When `event.onCandle` fires: once the bar closes ("confirmed"), or once its last block is finalized ("final").

```ts
type ActOn = "confirmed" | "final"
```

### Resolution {#resolution}

Bar size. "1B" makes every block one bar.

```ts
type Resolution = | "1B" | "1m" | "3m" | "5m" | "15m" | "30m" | "1h" | "2h" | "4h" | "6h" | "12h" | "1D" | "1W"
```

### Side {#side}

```ts
type Side = "buy" | "sell"
```

### Market {#market}

A subnet's alpha market, e.g. "ALPHA:61" for subnet 61.

```ts
type Market = `ALPHA:${number}`
```
